canonical_terms.definition: Typed observation emitted from bounded product evidence before issue synthesis.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The stated source and run produced the typed observation.

canonical_terms.definition: Unresolved issue hypothesis retained for further evidence collection.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The hypothesis exists and its unresolved obligations are recorded.

canonical_terms.definition: Canonical issue hypothesis with exact scope, claim type and immutable product-artifact identity.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The hypothesis is eligible to enter proof compilation and technical validation.

canonical_terms.definition: Versioned evidence bundle or certificate that records satisfied, refuted and unresolved obligations.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The named obligations have the exact evidence state recorded by the proof artifact.

canonical_terms.definition: VALIDATE technical verdict stating that the typed claim is supported by a complete proof under the sealed inputs.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The claim is technically supported for the exact candidate, run and evidence set.

canonical_terms.definition: VALIDATE technical verdict stating that counterevidence or an effective protection contradicts the candidate claim.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The exact candidate claim is refuted for the sealed inputs.

canonical_terms.definition: VALIDATE technical verdict stating that one or more mandatory obligations remain unresolved, unavailable or over budget.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The current evidence cannot support or refute the exact candidate claim.

canonical_terms.definition: FILTER admission decision for a VALIDATE-supported candidate whose mandatory independent gates pass.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The supported candidate is admitted to the finding projection for the exact run.

canonical_terms.definition: FILTER admission decision preserving a supported candidate for human or additional evidence review because admission is not closed.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The candidate remains non-terminal in the publication plane with explicit review debt.

canonical_terms.definition: FILTER admission decision excluding a supported input from publication for an independently demonstrated policy, protection, source or duplication reason.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The candidate is not admitted to the finding projection for the recorded reason.

canonical_terms.definition: PublishedFinding projection backed by a VALIDATE-supported verdict, FILTER pass, publication eligibility and the exact immutable candidate and run lineage.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The product published the exact admitted technical result.

canonical_terms.definition: Evaluator linkage between a frozen product result and one exact oracle or ground-truth item after product outputs are sealed.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The evaluator linked the two immutable identities under the declared matching policy.

canonical_terms.definition: Finding credited to an exact evaluation denominator through a verified post-product match.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The stated finding was credited within the named cohort, denominator, matcher and evaluation run.

canonical_terms.definition: Regression or evaluation material whose oracle identity is part of a predeclared known corpus.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The result belongs to the exact named known corpus and version.

canonical_terms.definition: Evaluation whose cohort was committed before execution and whose oracle remained inaccessible to the product boundary, with independently verified role and capability separation.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The exact run satisfied the declared sealed holdout and separation contract.

canonical_terms.definition: Independently adjudicated finding absent from the committed known corpora and the declared prior-art search scope at the cutoff.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The finding met the exact novelty policy, search scope and cutoff recorded by the adjudicator.

canonical_terms.definition: Attribution to an identified human reviewer with a declared role, scope, credentials and signed review artifact.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The named reviewer performed the exact declared review.

canonical_terms.definition: Versioned product artifact published only after its exact candidate epoch, release gates, evidence dossier and immutable tag or equivalent publication identity are complete.
canonical_terms.permitted_assertion: The exact artifact and version were published under the recorded release evidence.

forbidden_aliases.reason: The alias mixes product admission with authorization of release claims.
The alias mixes technical truth with FILTER publication admission.

allowed_only_when: the reference is explicitly described as legacy, deprecated, compatibility-only or forbidden
or the serialized field is shown with the literal value false and grants no positive claim

compatibility_debt.statement: C0-002 forbids new claim authority from legacy aliases and inventories active documentation; it does not rewrite serialized product contracts before their registered migration task.
